top_signals.title: Stocks Edge Lower as Rate Hike Rumbles Offset Nvidia’s Rally
top_signals.summary: US stocks closed little changed on Wednesday, erasing an earlier climb, after Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari’s comment that it’s time for the central bank to start slowly raising rates. Megacap Nvidia Corp. extended its rally to a fifth day, boosted by confidence in artificial-intelligence related spending. The stock contributed the most to the S&P 500 Index on a points basis Wednesday.

alerts.title: Hourly peak load in ERCOT set a new record, exceeding 91 GW on July 22
alerts.summary: Hourly peak load in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT), the regional transmission organization serving most of Texas, reached a record 91.1 gigawatts (GW) on July 22, 2026, according to data reported to us for our Hourly Electric Grid Monitor.
